subject: Request: SOC 2 evidence - SSO/SCIM snapshots & ownership mapping
messages:
From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@medallionhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@medallionhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-17T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 evidence - SSO/SCIM snapshots & ownership mapping

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier this week. For our upcoming SOC 2 readiness review we need a compact evidence bundle scoped to the redwood-prod tenant covering Sep 1 - Oct 1, 2026. Can you confirm whether you can provide the following artifacts?

- SAML assertion samples (5 anonymized examples showing NameID, attributes, issuer, and timestamps)
- SCIM delta log for user adds/modifies/deletes (CSV or a compressed log)
- Access ownership matrix (roles -> owner, owner email, last attested date)
- Inventory of service accounts and their provisioning flow (who creates, who approves)
- A brief note on how least-privilege is validated for high-priv roles

Our security team prefers hashed user IDs rather than raw emails in any drop for privacy; is that possible on your side? Also please propose an ETA for a small sample (1-2 records) via a secure drive link so our auditors can validate format before the full deliverable.

Can we aim for delivery by COB Oct 20? If not, flag the blockers and we can agree a staggered handoff.

Appreciate the help — looping in Procurement for contract timing.

Best,

Jenna Park
Security Manager
Medallion Health

Attachments: None
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@medallionhealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-17T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 evidence - SSO/SCIM snapshots & ownership mapping

Hi Jenna — thanks for the clear checklist. We can provide all of the requested artifacts. High-level plan below and an ask on redaction: we can replace emails with a SHA256 hash of the principal id; that will preserve determinism for mapping while removing PII. Please confirm that meets your policy.

Planned deliverables and ETA:
- SAML assertion examples (5 anonymized CSV rows) — sample by Oct 18, full set by Oct 20
- SCIM delta (events) compressed as ZIP with CSV manifest — initial sample Oct 18, full by Oct 20
- Access ownership matrix (xlsx) — draft Oct 19, final Oct 20
- Service account inventory and provisioning notes (short doc) — Oct 20
- Short write-up on least-privilege validation & role attestation cadence — Oct 20

Ownership on our side:
- I will own the SCIM & SAML extracts and audit traces (rishi.malhotra)
- Laura Bennett will own the access matrix delivery and redaction review (laura.bennett)
- Marissa Cole will coordinate Pack delivery and the secure drive handoff (marissa.cole)

Delivery method: secure Drive link (view-only) + separate verification call with CloudAssure if you want a witness.

If hashed IDs are OK, I'll prepare the sample drop this afternoon.

Thanks,

--
Rishi Malhotra
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: saml-assertion-examples.csv (stub), scim-delta-sample.csv (stub)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@medallionhealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-18T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 evidence - SSO/SCIM snapshots & ownership mapping

Hi Jenna — quick note from me: hashed user IDs are fine and is our standard approach for 3rd-party evidence drops. We will also apply minimal redaction for display names if present in logs. Marissa will upload a sample bundle to a restricted Drive folder; please confirm which drive domain you prefer (medallionhealth.com or an external SSO-protected folder).

Operational constraints to call out: the SCIM delta includes webhooks and system-to-system events that may show internal service account churn. If you want those filtered, flag the event types (e.g., ServiceAccount.Create, ServiceAccount.Update). To satisfy auditors we typically provide a separate service-account inventory CSV and an annotated provisioning flow rather than removing events entirely.

Proposed secure link (will be active for 7 days): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_secure_drop
HubSpot reference: HS-982173 (for procurement & delivery tracking)

I'll be available for a 30-minute review session tomorrow morning if you'd like to walk through the sample.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Attachments: None
From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@medallionhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: CloudAssure Auditor <auditor@cloudassure.io>, Procurement <procure@medallionhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 evidence - SSO/SCIM snapshots & ownership mapping

Thanks Rishi/Laura — hashing is acceptable. A couple quick clarifications from our audit team (CC'd CloudAssure):

1) Service accounts: please include a separate CSV that enumerates service account names, owner (team), creation date, and whether MFA is enforced for the provisioning user.
2) Least-privilege validation: can you include the last attestation date for roles that map to admin-level capabilities and a short note on how automated checks flag privilege escalations?
3) SCIM format: the auditor prefers RFC-compliant SCIM CSV where possible; can you confirm the field names you will include (id, userName, meta.created, meta.lastModified, operations)?

If you can drop the sample by COB Oct 19 we'll run a quick format check and then request the full bundle.

Best,

Jenna Park
Security Manager
Medallion Health
